scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('python3 --version', {stdio: 'ignore'}); } catch(e) { console.log('python3 not found, skipping venv'); process.exit(0); } require('child_process').execSync('python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
